about: How a body is posed, from V1 characters.ts (RPG-game trunk 82a994d15). No crossfades: every clip plays all the time and its weight eases toward a target at `weightRate` /s (exp). Locomotion blends idle, walk, the two strafes and run by the smoothed travel speed; the combat clip fades in over progress x `fadeIn` and out over (1 - progress) x `fadeOut`, snapping to full through the blade's active ticks. Swings are scrubbed by sim progress through the keys below (a slow wind-up, a snap through contact, a slow tail) instead of played at a constant rate.
